rationale.complete: Rounds 1 and 1b done: synthetic validation, 12 periods, a second embedding model, work-ledger labels, a ledger copying test and three natives. Under scarce compute the full clustering ladder re-ran on 2 periods only; #22 not run; agent-field models not built.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction stays refuted (P1 failed; stated goals reject every exchangeable model in 5/5 free weeks). NCD fits only work labels in one shared-goal week (#30), tied with Hubbell and without its core signature. Half a point for a robust, well-understood refutation.
rationale.usefulness: Round 1b separates stated sub-tasks from work: work-label singleton fraction and copy-consistency are cheap monitors of whether a swarm shares effort, and copying is shown to follow reading, so announcing a project is the lever to test. Still no validated intervention.

one_line: No cooperative (NCD) dynamics: stated goals are private sub-tasks; work concentrates on shared repos with neutral copying at best, and copying follows reading.

models.note: NCD fails in 4/5 free weeks; Hubbell fits work at best
